about_the_game:
The Gold River Project™ throws you and your friends on an epic camping survival adventure! Try to escape a grueling experiment across one of the largest private nature reserves in the Pacific Northwest. You are being watched, studied and manipulated at every turn. Solve the mysteries within and try to survive another day.

CAMP SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS

Welcome to Gold River! A remote camping adventure you can play alone or with up to 4 friends. A chartered float plane will drop you off by beautiful lakes where you can kayak, hike the gorgeous trails, make camp and survive the elements.

A TRUE CAMPING SURVIVAL EXPERIENCE

One week turns into several as you suspect your guide is never coming back. Deserted, you discover you are trapped and now an unwilling lab rat. Can you survive an ever changing, artificial environment and it's inhabitants?

BRAVE THE ELEMENTS

Manage health, hydration, hunger, fatigue, and temperature. Use your survival skills and earn badges as you learn new ones. Outlast nature and uncover the perils of what lies beneath the surface.

EVOLVING SEASONS

The world shifts with time. Hunt in the abundance of summer, forage in the dying colors of fall, and fight for warmth in the frozen quiet of winter. Find your way through increasingly harsh environments and outsmart your captors to survive and escape.

THE WALL

Discover a mysterious barrier dividing the forest. Solve environmental puzzles, sneak past security patrols, or piece together scavenged tech to bring it down your own way.

FEATURES

  • Multiplayer: Survive by yourself or with friends in online co-op!

  • Crafting: Build survival equipment, weapons, farm plots and more to help you stay alive!

  • Research: Learn new things to craft from items you find or from trade.

  • Build: Expand your campsite to prepare for what's to come.

  • Scavenge: All items are all useful, it's up t﻿o you to figure it out how.

  • Puzzles, Stealth or Discovery: There is more than one way out.

  • Progress: Play at your own pace. No time restrictions.

  • Replayability: Substations, supplies and points of interest  - these locations change with each new play through.

content_descriptors.notes: There is simulated shooting and killing of other players and animals. Minimal blood and gore.

detailed_description:
JOIN OUR DISCORD

Need more information? Want to chat with fellow campers? Come on over and join our Discord channel!


DEMO INFO

The Demo offers a limited amount of playtime set in the Summer season, where each playthrough is unique. It’s a safe and welcoming environment to get familiar with the world and its systems. We’ll continue updating the demo with fixes and optimizations ahead of Early Access.

Early Access will introduce new seasons, expanded content, additional threats, unique challenges, and most importantly, unlimited playtime.

If your system can run the Demo, you can run the Early Access version.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit versions)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X 6-core or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 12GB / AMD RX 6800 XT or better
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires internet connection for multiplayer. Servers are player hosted.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600X 6-core or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3090 24GB / AMD RX 7900 XTX
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 60 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires internet connection for multiplayer. Servers are player hosted.

short_description: The Gold River Project™ invites you and your friends on an open world camping trip gone wrong. Alone or together, you must explore, craft, build, and survive the increasingly harsh environments of the Pacific Northwest wilderness as you uncover the experiment trapping you inside.
